allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Refactor get-concept to not reuse concepts across graphs

Concepts are now graph-specific nodes. Removed retrieve-concept call
that was reusing concepts from context cache across different graphs.

Within a single graph parse, concepts referring to the same individual
are still correctly identified as coreferent by looking up the
individual''s ID and checking find-local.

Also fixed bug where \(car individuals\) was returned directly instead
of creating a concept from the individual.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
